subject: general
question: What is the filtration unit of the kidney?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nephron**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **nephron** is the basic structural and functional unit of the kidney.
 
• It is responsible for the **filtration, reabsorption, secretion, and excretion of waste products and excess substances** from the blood.
 
• Each kidney contains millions of nephrons, which contribute to maintaining the body's **fluid and electrolyte balance**.
 
• The nephron consists of the following parts:
 
 
• **Bowman's Capsule:** Encapsulates the glomerulus and facilitates filtration.
 
• **Glomerulus:** A cluster of capillaries that filters blood to remove waste.
 
• **Proximal Convoluted Tubule:** Reabsorbs essential nutrients like glucose, amino acids, and ions.
 
• **Loop of Henle:** Concentrates urine by reabsorbing water and salts.
 
• **Distal Convoluted Tubule:** Adjusts the composition of filtrate by secreting ions and reabsorbing water.
 
• **Collecting Duct:** Finalizes urine composition and transports it to the renal pelvis.
 
 
 
• Nephrons play a critical role in regulating **blood pressure** through mechanisms like the **Renin-Angiotensin-Aldosterone System (RAAS).**
 
• They also help maintain the body's **acid-base balance** by excreting hydrogen ions and reabsorbing bicarbonate ions.
 
• The health of nephrons is essential for preventing conditions like **chronic kidney disease (CKD)** and **acute kidney injury (AKI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Neuron**__

 __
 
• A **neuron** is the basic unit of the nervous system, responsible for transmitting nerve impulses.
 
• It consists of three main parts: **cell body, dendrites, and axon.**
 
• Neurons are not involved in filtration processes; their function is in communication between the brain and other parts of the body.
 
 
 
• **Seminiferous tubule**__
 __
 
• **Seminiferous tubules** are located in the testes and are involved in the production of **sperm cells.**
 
• They are not related to the kidney or filtration functions.
 
 
 
• **Sperm**__
 
 
• **Sperm** is the male reproductive cell, produced in the testes.
 
• It has no role in kidney filtration or the excretion of waste products.
